violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Wiping cloth bucket solution should be water and bleach. Do not add soap.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. Glass door upright refrigerator running warm. Products temping at 48 degrees F.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. Adjust items in upright reach in cooler to allow for better air circulation. Monitor product temperatures. Adjust temperature setting as needed.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Keep hand sink clear of items to encourage proper hand washing.
Clean, proper temperature, cleaning agent (2 pts deducted)
Clean dry location, protected (1 pt deducted)
